question: When a liquid tanker comes to a stop, what happens to the liquid inside the tank?
choice_a: It instantly settles and has no effect on vehicle handling
choice_b: It evaporates rapidly, reducing tank pressure
choice_c: It freezes against the tank walls, adding weight
